title:
Töödokument - COMMISSION STAFF WORKING DOCUMENT
Analysis by the Commission services of the budgetary situation in Portugal following the
adoption of the COUNCIL RECOMMENDATION to Portugal on 21 June 2013 with a
view to bringing an end to the situation of an excessive government deficit and the
COUNCIL DECISION of 12 July 2016 establishing that no effective action has been
taken by Portugal in response to the Council Recommendation of 21 June 2013
Accompanying the document
Recommendation for a
COUNCIL DECISION
giving notice to Portugal to take measures for the deficit reduction judged necessary in
order to remedy the situation of excessive deficit
SWD(2016)264; COM(2016) 520
